description: This PHP source file defines a class RegistrationEventPersistSubscriber that subscribes to EmployeeSavedEvent events within the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling registration event persistence when employee data is saved.

classes.name: RegistrationEventPersistSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class listening for employee saved events to persist registration related events.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping EmployeeSavedEvent to the handler method onEmployeeSaved.

methods.name: onEmployeeSaved
methods.description: Handles the EmployeeSavedEvent by creating registration event processors for active and inactive employees and invoking their saveRegistrationEvent method.
